## Appearance

Dinah Wren is an extremely attractive woman with gentle eyes. She also has dark hair that is easily ruffled by the breeze.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P40](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0040)_

## History

Dinah Wren spent her childhood in the countryside and harbored a constant desire to return there. Before arriving in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), she was afflicted with consumption. She ultimately died at the age of twenty-two and was commemorated with a small brown monument featuring sculpted opening gates.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P49](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0049), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051)_
